entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Boss said he reserved the place just for us.[n]We're free to drink as much coffee as we[n]want.
entries.uk: Шеф сказав, що зачинив кав'ярню лише[n]для нас. Каву можна пити скільки[n]завгодно.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't this place always empty though?
entries.uk: А хіба тут і так не завжди порожньо?

entries.en: True.
That's rude.
I'm telling Boss.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should show appreciation for his[n]kindness, you know.
entries.uk: Знаєш, нам слід бути вдячними[n]за його доброту.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's ignore those details and just be[n]happy with what we have.
entries.uk: Облишмо ці дрібниці й просто[n]радіймо тому, що маємо.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're right.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let's just call it a hidden gem.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Everyone here is a witness.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: U-Uh, I was just jokin'...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, we're supposed to be discussing[n]where we should send the calling card...
entries.uk: Ем, ми ж мали обговорити, куди[n]надсилати візитну картку...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Considering how big the hype's gotten,[n]she'll prolly just think it's a prank,[n]won't she?
entries.uk: Зважаючи на те, який здійнявся[n]ажіотаж, вона ж, мабуть, вирішить,[n]що це розіграш?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I could always put it on Sae-san's desk.[n]People know me there, so I could gain[n]access easily.
entries.uk: Я міг би покласти її на стіл Сае.[n]Мене там знають, тож зайти мені[n]було б легко.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's not a good idea. If you're the only[n]one who can get in there, it'll be easily[n]traced back to you.
entries.uk: Погана ідея. Якщо зайти туди можеш лише[n]ти, слід одразу приведе до тебе.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I'll do it. I can just tell her it came for[n]her in the mail.
entries.uk: ...Це зроблю я. Просто скажу, що вона[n]прийшла їй поштою.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That would be the least risky method.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No matter what she asks, I'll tell her[n]I don't know anything.
entries.uk: Хай що вона питатиме, я відповім,[n]що нічого не знаю.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But Makoto, that's...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're our leader, so this will be up to[n]you. Should we leave the calling card[n]to Makoto?
entries.uk: Ти наш лідер, тож вирішувати тобі.[n]Довіримо візитну картку Макото?

entries.en: I trust her with it.
That's the only way.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is that... really the only way?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We're asking too much from Makoto,[n]though...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll be okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've already traversed far more dangerous[n]ground than this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We will leave it to you then. Thank you[n]for agreeing to this.
entries.uk: Тоді покладаємося на тебе.[n]Дякую, що погодилася.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I will need to step up my game as well[n]to make up for it...
entries.uk: Мені теж доведеться постаратися,[n]щоб не пасти задніх...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well then. We'll enter from in front[n]of the courthouse.
entries.uk: Що ж, гаразд. Заходимо з місця перед[n]будівлею суду.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Does six o'clock in the evening work for[n]everyone?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yup, got it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Same as always.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well then, let's get ready for tomorrow![n]Dismissed!
